name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: An income support scheme for landholding farmer families across India to supplement financial needs for agricultural inputs and domestic expenses.

benefits.summary: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank account in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.

eligibility_summary: Landholding farmer families • Age 18–75 • Income under ₹15 Lakhs

application_process.title: Online Registration
application_process.description: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) and click on 'Farmers Corner'.

application_process.title: Fill Aadhaar & State Details
application_process.description: Enter your Aadhaar number, state, and verify with OTP.

application_process.title: Upload Land Records
application_process.description: Upload scanned copies of land title documents and bank passbook.

application_process.title: Verification & Approval
application_process.description: State Nodal Officer verifies records and approves direct transfer.

name: PMAY-U (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban / Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Interest subsidy on home loans for purchasing or constructing first pucca house for EWS, LIG, and MIG families.

benefits.subsidy_rate: 6.5% interest subsidy on loan up to ₹6 Lakhs
benefits.summary: Up to ₹2.67 Lakh upfront interest subsidy credited directly to home loan account.

eligibility_summary: First home buyers • Household income below ₹18 Lakhs • Age 21–70
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Self-declaration of not owning a pucca house in India

application_process.title: Apply for Home Loan
application_process.description: Approach any Primary Lending Institution (Bank/HFC) for home loan under PMAY.

application_process.title: Submit Subsidy Claim
application_process.description: Fill out PMAY-CLSS application form at lender branch.

application_process.title: Central Nodal Agency Review
application_process.description: NHB/HUDCO validates claim and releases subsidy to bank.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed monthly pension scheme for citizens in the unorganised sector, providing ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 monthly pension from age 60.

benefits.summary: Fixed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month after turning 60 years.

eligibility_summary: Indian Citizens • Age 18–40 • Non-taxpayers in unorganised sector
documents_required: Savings Bank account with auto-debit facility

application_process.title: Visit Bank/Post Office
application_process.description: Visit the bank branch or post office where you hold a savings account.

application_process.title: Fill APY Form
application_process.description: Select desired monthly pension amount (₹1k-5k) and nominate beneficiary.

application_process.title: Enable Auto-Debit
application_process.description: Set up monthly auto-debit contribution from bank account.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: World's largest government-funded healthcare insurance scheme providing health cover of ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

benefits.summary: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per family annually at empanelled public and private hospitals across India.

eligibility_summary: EWS & SECC 2011 listed families • Income under ₹5 Lakhs • Cashless treatment
documents_required: Ayushman Bharat Card or PM-JAY letter

application_process.title: Check Eligibility
application_process.description: Visit mera.pmjay.gov.in or call 14555 to check SECC eligibility.

application_process.title: Visit Empanelled Hospital
application_process.description: Present Aadhaar card to Ayushman Mitra at hospital helpdesk.

application_process.title: Get Cashless Treatment
application_process.description: Hospital conducts treatment cashlessly up to ₹5 Lakh.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: A government-backed small deposit scheme targeted at the parents of a girl child to build a dedicated fund for higher education or marriage.

benefits.benefit_type: High Interest Savings & Tax Free Return
benefits.summary: High guaranteed interest rate of 8.2% p.a. with 100% tax-free maturity returns.

eligibility_summary: Parents/guardians of girl child below 10 years • Max 2 accounts per family

application_process.title: Visit Post Office or Bank
application_process.description: Visit nearest India Post branch or authorized commercial bank.

application_process.title: Submit SSY Form
application_process.description: Attach child's birth certificate and guardian KYC documents.

application_process.title: Make Initial Deposit
application_process.description: Deposit minimum ₹250 to open account (max ₹1.5 Lakh per fiscal year).

name: PMSBY (Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana)
description: An affordable accidental death and disability insurance scheme available at a nominal premium of ₹20 per annum.

benefits.summary: ₹2 Lakh cover for accidental death/permanent total disability at just ₹20/year.

eligibility_summary: Bank account holders • Age 18–70 • Nominal ₹20/year premium
documents_required: Savings Bank account with auto-debit authorization

application_process.title: Log in to Net Banking
application_process.description: Log in to internet banking or mobile app of your bank.

application_process.title: Select Social Security Schemes
application_process.description: Click on PMSBY and enable auto-debit of ₹20/year.

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
description: A government-backed risk-free savings scheme offering high quarterly interest payouts specifically designed for senior citizens.

benefits.summary: 8.2% annual interest paid quarterly with deposit limit up to ₹30 Lakhs.

eligibility_summary: Senior Citizens age 60+ (or retired defense personnel 55+) • Max ₹30 Lakh deposit

application_process.title: Visit Bank or Post Office
application_process.description: Obtain Form-A for SCSS account opening.

application_process.title: Submit Age & KYC Proof
application_process.description: Attach PAN, Aadhaar, and retirement certificate if applicable.

application_process.title: Deposit Funds
application_process.description: Deposit funds up to ₹30 Lakhs by cheque or DD.
